decision: Plan B fills the intent + diff layers Plan A reserved empty: an ADR/doc intent extractor (declared claims) + a conservative as-built↔intent reconciler. New module architecture_intent.py; build_view_state populates layers.intent + layers.diff. No new code extractors (Plan C), no UI, no Plan A contract change.
rationale: Sequenced after Plan A's contract + 008's usability; turns as-built-only into as-built-vs-intended without expanding code-extractor coverage yet.

decision: v0 reconciler emits only evidence-backed diff classes: aligned, documented_unimplemented, stale_adr. implemented_undocumented / conflicting_dependency / unknown_confidence / drift stay defined-but-unemitted until code-extractor coverage (Plan C) can defend them.
rationale: Render-truth: never emit a diff class the evidence can't support; honest partial coverage over a confident-but-wrong reconciliation.

decision: ADR claims are evidence_basis=declared, source_kind=adr — intent, never as-built fact. Absence of docs/adr degrades to empty intent + coverage adr=not_found, never a crash (most repos have no ADRs).
rationale: The operator contract: ADRs are optional enrichment; the map must say 'no ADRs found', not fail.

decision: Closed completed: shipped + merged to main as PR #27 (Plan B ADR intent extractor + as-built↔intent diff); audited under the 2026-06-08 retroactive Codex audit + remediation. Status flipped from active to completed in the 2026-06-08 close-out pass.
rationale: Ledger reconciliation — all features passed + merged + audited; status had lagged reality.
